{{Short description|Set of points associated with a triangle's circumconic centers}}
{{inline |date=May 2024}}
[[File:Thomson cubic.svg|thumb|upright=2.5|The Thomson cubic (black curve) contains the point ''X'' whose isogonal conjugate (''X{{'}}'') is on the line ''X''(2)-''X''.]]
In [[geometry]], the '''Thomson cubic''' of a [[triangle]] is the [[locus (mathematics)|locus]] of centers of [[circumconic]]s whose normals at the [[Vertex (geometry)|vertices]] are [[concurrent lines|concurrent]].
